cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called "the cleaner of the desert."

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.description: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Galarian Stunfisk
cards.description: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.description: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.description: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

cards.name: Trumbeak
cards.description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

cards.name: Toucannon
cards.description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.description: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.description: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Barraskewda
cards.description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.description: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.description: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.description: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
